aboutDescription: A music player for the libraries you already run. It streams from your own Subsonic-compatible or Jellyfin server, from an Apple Music or NetEase account, and from plugins you install; it plays files you import onto the device. Every answer, lyric and play stays on this device.
aboutSolarNetworkDescription: The account behind presence sharing, library sync and AI lyric translation. Your music never goes through it.
aboutOpenSourceLicensesHint: GroovyBox and every package it ships.
